first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence supports improvements from shorter onboarding and simpler signup. A small guarded test can address both leading indicators while limiting the risk that reduced friction lowers lead quality or downstream qualified revenue. I would defer promotional pricing because it may respond to competitor pressure but could erode sustainable revenue and quality.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding to address the 4% completion decline directly. The verified prior result showed completion up 13%, time-to-value reduced by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention up 3%, making it the strongest evidence for sustainable long-term value. Monitor qualified revenue and retention to ensure the simplification does not reduce downstream account quality.
